ankle.df.src: Loram, Maganaris & Lakie 2007a [M]: long-range relaxed ankle stiffness in standing, 46 N·m/rad per leg; slack = anatomical neutral [D]

knee.flex.src: Riener & Edrich 1999 [E]: passive knee stiffness at 14.2° flexion (≈ 16 at 15°, 26 at 10°); slack = passive zero-moment angle ≈ 14°

hip.flex.src: Riener & Edrich 1999 [E]: passive hip stiffness at 7.4° flexion (20.6 at 5°, 17.8 at 10°); slack = passive zero-moment angle 26.8° (knee extended)

lumbar.flex.src: Watt 2022 table [M/R]: lumbar neutral-zone stiffness ≈ 10 N·m/rad; slack = neutral

neck.flex.src: Liu et al. 2024 [M]: zone-1 neck stiffness 2.1 (flexion) / 1.1 (extension) N·m/rad, mean; slack = neutral

neck.lat.src: Liu et al. 2024 [M]: zone-1 lateral bending ≈ 2.4 N·m/rad; slack = neutral
